title: Induced Pluripotent Stem Cells for Niemann Pick Disease
brief_summary: Establishment of individualized human cellular disease models based on induced pluripotent stem cells that reflect the broad heterogeneous phenotypic spectrum of Niemann Pick disease
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Informed consent will be obtained from the patient or the parents before any study related procedures
* Patients of both genders older than 6 months and younger than 80 years
* The patient has a diagnosis of Niemann Pick disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* No Informed consent from the patient or the parents before any study related procedures
* Patients of both genders younger than 6 months or older than 80 years
* No diagnosis of Niemann Pick disease
study_population: The patient has a diagnosis of Niemann Pick disease
